sources.text:
Olvassuo Strict Nature Reserve (Olvassuon luonnonpuisto) encompasses 71 square kilometres (27 mi2) in the Northern Ostrobothnia and Kainuu regions of Finland. It is situated inside a larger, 270 km2 (100 mi2) protected area. It was designated in 1981.
The reserve is part of Natura 2000 and Ramsar programmes.
